items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he and Benny had when Tootie was playing with them incidentally. You remember the Jazztet?

ctx.x: Yeah, maybe it was Gilly. But the Symphony Sid All-Stars, and oh yeah, JJ Johnson was in that too. We played around there in the Downbeat with that group. The two clubs were interrelated anyhow. Being in New York then working sometimes with Miles, made these record dates with Miles and everybody else who recorded for Prestige at that time, Thad Jones, you mentioned Art Farmer, who had left the Jazztet, he and Benny had when Tootie was playing with them incidentally. You remember the Jazztet?
Wasn’t the Jazztet later? I thought the Jazztet was formed like in 1959. But there was a Jazztet…
